recession_risk.label: Moderate
recession_risk.plain_english_summary: There are some warning signs but no imminent recession signal. Worth keeping an eye on.
factors: The yield curve is flattening (spread: 0.87%). It is positive but historically narrow — when a curve steepens back up after an inversion, recessions have often followed.
Market volatility (VIX: 17.68) is creeping above its calm baseline.
GDP growth is 1.6% — below the ~2% trend. Sustained 'stall speed' growth has historically preceded recessions.

real_world_impact.mortgages: No immediate concern. Fixed rates are relatively stable.
real_world_impact.credit_cards: No major rate changes expected in the near term.
real_world_impact.savings: A good time to build your emergency fund — always valuable regardless of conditions.
